title: A common canonical-trace annihilator bounds modification cohomology
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ and let $W$ be a finite $A$-module with $W[2]$ a normalized algebraic dualizing complex [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. For every normal modification $a:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, meaning $a$ proper, $Z$ normal integral, and the induced map on function fields an isomorphism, let $\omega_Z$ and $\tau_a:\Gamma(Z,\omega_Z)\to W$ be the canonical module and its proper trace from [lem-per-coherent-normal-surface-trace-calculus]. If there is a single $0\ne d\in A$ with $d\,\operatorname{coker}(\tau_a)=0$ for every such $a$, then there is an integer $N\geq0$ such that $\operatorname{length}_A H^1(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},\mathcal O_Z)\leq N$ for every such $a$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length], [def-sc-zariski-cohomology].

source.place: Tag 0B4S, resolve-lemma-bound-dualizing-implies-bound (using a normalized shift W[2]); normal modification convention at resolve-definition-reduce-to-rational, Tag 0B4N.
